findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: Only references [1], [2], [4], and [8] are cited in the body text. References [3], [5], [6], [7], [9], [10], [11], and [12] appear in the reference list but are never cited in the text, tables, or figure legends. The cited references also have non-sequential numbering (1, 2, 4, 8) with gaps where the uncited entries sit.

findings.location: Reference [11]: Itoh, H., et al. Mechanically driven ATP synthesis by F1-ATPase. Nature (in press).
findings.rule: When the Reference has a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), it should be added by its URL. The journal's own example for an in-press article (example [6] in the Instructions) includes a DOI URL.
findings.problem: Reference [11] is listed as 'Nature (in press)' with no DOI URL, whereas the Instructions' worked example for an in-press article shows the DOI (https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212) appended to the entry.
